lastTask: Implement Byte L4c-1 new idea authoring

projectState.summary: Byte L4c-1 is implemented on codex/byte-l4c1-new-idea and ready for Claude review. The melody editor now has a small + New idea affordance plus window.phraseEditor.newIdea(), which seeds a pure minimal 1->5->1 AnchorPhrase template into edit mode as a transient New idea/new-unsaved draft catalog entry. The draft is immediately audible through the existing editorMelodyOverride path, remains in-session until saved, and Save reuses the L4a writeCandidate flow to persist a scored native anchor-phrase/v1 candidate in editor-<songId>; the draft entry clears after save and generated prosody stays unchanged. No persistence endpoint, schema, server normalizer, renderer, scorer, transport, scheduling, or candidate-store logic changed. Validation: build green, six unit suites green, targeted new-idea smoke green, full smoke 77/77 twice on a reused non-clean DB, db:smoke green, diff-check green; npm audit still reports known Vite/esbuild advisories.
